top_risks.rationale: Default `r` filetype globs dropped lowercase `*.rmd` and `*.rnw`; users invoking `-t r` will silently stop matching files that previously matched.
top_risks.subject: crates/ignore/src/default_types.rs:DEFAULT_TYPES

top_risks.rationale: When CWD discovery fails, build() falls back to ig_builder.build() with no CWD — global gitignores are silently disabled (logged only), not surfaced to the caller.
top_risks.subject: crates/ignore/src/walk.rs:WalkBuilder::build

top_risks.rationale: Public `Gitignore::global()` now depends on `current_dir()`; on failure it returns an empty matcher plus error, changing behavior for callers that previously got globals built relative to `""`.
top_risks.subject: crates/ignore/src/gitignore.rs:Gitignore::global
